name: ssh-ops
description: Operate Linux and Windows servers via SSH from Codex and the CLI using YAML configuration: run commands, deploy code, inspect logs, restart services, transfer files, and manage background jobs on bash servers. Connections are reused within each process.

interface.shortDescription: SSH server operations for agents and humans from one YAML config.
interface.longDescription: SSH Ops gives coding agents scriptable SSH operations on Linux and Windows servers. Server definitions and reusable command aliases live in YAML files; the same core runs as a CLI and as an MCP server with stdio or HTTP transports. It covers command execution, SFTP transfer, remote text editing, background jobs on bash servers, and byte-paged log reads. Connections are reused within each process. Host-key checks, optional command filters, path allow-lists, and sudo limitations are documented in SECURITY.md and docs/reference.md.
